purpose: .nodeset selects the operating point of a bistable circuit.

oracle.derivation: Gummel-Poon at 27 degC (IS = 1e-16, BF = 100, BR = 1, no resistances, GMIN = 1e-12 across each junction): KCL at q, qb, b1, b2 solved by scipy.optimize.root (method lm) from the state .nodeset selects (q high, Q1 off, Q2 saturated), residual 7e-19 A. ngspice-44.2 at reltol 1e-7 abstol 1e-15 vntol 1e-12 gives v(qb) = 0.0735649384 (8e-8 off). The previous oracle, ngspice at default reltol, had v(qb) = 0.0735823, 24x its 1e-5 tolerance off. Xyce 7.10.0 settles on the symmetric metastable point (v(q) = v(qb) = 1.1862 V).
